author: worker_2
object: Singapore's five most recent DPMs as of Nov 20, 2023
belief: The five most recent Deputy Prime Ministers of Singapore in chronological order (by first appointment) as of November 20, 2023 are: 1) Wong Kan Seng (May 30, 2006), 2) Teo Chee Hean (April 1, 2009), 3) Tharman Shanmugaratnam (May 21, 2011), 4) Heng Swee Keat (May 1, 2019), 5) Lawrence Wong (June 13, 2022)

author: worker_2
belief: Teo Chee Hean attended the University of Manchester (BSc, 1976), Imperial College London (MSc, 1977), and Harvard University (MPA, 1986). His primary university is the University of Manchester.

author: worker_3
belief: Tharman Shanmugaratnam attended the London School of Economics (BSc in Economics), University of Cambridge (MPhil in Economics), and Harvard University (MPA).

author: worker_4
belief: Heng Swee Keat (4th DPM) attended the University of Cambridge (BA in Economics, 1983) and Harvard University (MPA, 1993).

author: worker_4
belief: Lawrence Wong (5th DPM) attended the University of Wisconsin-Madison (BS in Economics, 1994), University of Michigan (MA in Applied Economics, 1995), and Harvard University (MPA, 2004).
